identity.title: CAT3D: Create Anything in 3D with Multi-View Diffusion Models

problem.claim: Create 3D scenes from any number of input images and target novel viewpoints, without requiring extensive real-world image capture.

gap.claim: Existing high-quality 3D capture requires hundreds to thousands of images from the user.

contributions.claim: CAT3D simulates the real-world capture process using a multi-view diffusion model to generate consistent novel views.
The generated views can feed robust 3D reconstruction methods, yielding representations renderable from arbitrary viewpoints in real time.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors present CAT3D as a multi-view-diffusion approach for creating anything in 3D by simulating image capture.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that CAT3D can create complete 3D scenes in as little as one minute.
The authors report that CAT3D outperforms existing methods for single-image and few-view 3D scene creation.

narrative_sequence.summary: High-quality 3D reconstruction is presented as image-intensive, often requiring hundreds to thousands of captures.
CAT3D simulates this capture process with a multi-view diffusion model.
Given input images and target viewpoints, it generates consistent novel views for downstream 3D reconstruction and real-time rendering.
The authors report scene creation in as little as one minute and superiority over existing single-image and few-view methods.

source_observation.claim: The abstract explicitly connects generated novel views to downstream reconstruction and specifies the resulting rendering capability.

lessons.interpretation: A contribution is easier to assess when the intermediate representation, downstream use, and concrete capability are linked.
lessons.application: Describe a generative component together with the representation it produces, its downstream consumer, and the resulting user-visible capability.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when the work is purely theoretical or has no meaningful downstream pipeline.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the number or type of input images, target viewpoints, datasets, evaluation metrics, or the basis and magnitude of the reported comparisons.
The conditions under which the one-minute creation time and real-time rendering claims hold are unspecified.
